title: 第3章 吞噬囚犯第4章 恶人庞烈
content_zh:
“楚，楚峰，你竟然胆敢越狱！”
那狱卒紧握铁鞭，一脸怒气的朝着楚峰抽了过去。
“正好，可以报之前的仇了！”
楚峰伸出手掌，将铁鞭给牢牢抓住，然后猛然一拉，狱卒的身体便朝着楚峰飞了过去！
狱卒瞪大了眼睛，满脸惊骇：
“怎么会？你的力量……”
然而，他话还未说完，脖子便被楚峰一把掐住，给提了起来。
他满脸通红，眼神之中尽是惊恐之色。
双手不停地扒拉着楚峰的手掌，想要挣脱，却无济于事！
楚峰双眼死死盯着他。
就是此人，差点将自己给抽打致死！
“死！”
咔嚓一声，狱卒的脖子便被捏断。
“啧啧，小子，有点浪费了啊！
你可以直接将他吞噬了，提升修为！
不过也不打紧，天牢深处，那里还有很多囚犯，将他们给吞了。”
楚峰听完顿时吓了一跳。
直接吞噬人来修炼？
这不就是妥妥的魔功吗？
难道这葫灵是一个魔头吗？

他突然想到刚才他恢复修为的时候，那一道道灵气，该不会…
“怎么，有心理负担？这里可是天牢，里面大多数都是囚犯。
虽然不乏像你这样被人陷害蒙冤之人，但总体上，应该都算不得上什么好人。
他们现在都已经被废了，有的人甚至比你还惨，死亡对于他们而言，就是一种解脱。
你吞吸了他们一身的灵力，也算是他们生前的一点赎罪吧。
而且，本灵为你恢复修为的时候，就已经吞吸了一部分的人，不然你以为你能恢复修为？
本灵可没有精力再帮助一个人恢复修为了。
到底怎么做，你可要想清楚了，你的家人还等着你去营救呢？”
没错！
我还要救我的家人。
楚峰走向天牢深处。
一路上，他见到了那些被神秘人吞吸致死的囚犯。
他们各个都只剩下一副皮包骨。
一身的精华都已经被吞噬得干干净净。
不过，他看到了他们脸上似乎都露出一副解脱的表情。
这副情形，令他感到毛骨悚然。
“小子，那些人的死是你做的？”
当楚峰来到天牢深处一间牢房时，一道声音从左侧一个牢房传来。
“嗯？你就当是我做的吧！”
楚峰走进那间牢房。

里面关押的是一位老者，满脸胡须，因为跪在地上的缘故，头发已经长的散落在地。
显然，是关了很长时间。
content_en:
"Chu, Chu Feng, you dare to escape from prison!"
The jailer grasped the iron whip tightly and whipped it towards Chu Feng with an angry look on his face.
"Just in time, we can take revenge for the past!"
Chu Feng stretched out his palm, grasped the iron whip firmly, and then pulled it suddenly, and the jailer's body flew towards Chu Feng!
The jailer's eyes widened with horror on his face:
"How could it be? Your power..."
However, before he finished speaking, Chu Feng grabbed his neck and lifted him up.
His face was red, and his eyes were filled with fear.
Both hands kept pulling Chu Feng's palm, trying to break free, but to no avail!
Chu Feng stared at him intently.
This was the man who almost beat himself to death!
"Death!"
With a click, the jailer's neck was crushed.
“Tsk, tsk, boy, it’s a bit of a waste!
You can devour him directly and improve your cultivation!
But it doesn't matter, deep in the sky prison, there are still many prisoners there, and they have been swallowed up. "
Chu Feng was shocked after hearing this.
Directly swallowing people to practice?
Isn't this a proper magic power?
Could it be that this gourd spirit is a demon?
He suddenly thought about the spiritual energy that he had when he recovered his cultivation just now, could it be...
"Why, are you feeling psychologically burdened? This is a prison, and most of them are prisoners.
Although there are many people like you who have been framed and wronged, on the whole, they are probably not good people.
They have all been crippled now, and some are even worse off than you. Death is a kind of relief for them.
You swallowed their spiritual power, which can be regarded as a little atonement for their sins during their lifetime.
Moreover, when this spirit restores your cultivation for you, it has already absorbed some people. Otherwise, do you think you can restore your cultivation?
This spirit does not have the energy to help another person recover his cultivation level.
You have to think clearly about what to do. Is your family still waiting for you to rescue? "
That's right!
I also want to save my family.
Chu Feng walked towards the depths of the prison.
Along the way, he saw prisoners who were swallowed to death by mysterious men.
All that was left of them was skin and bones.
All the essence of his body has been swallowed up.
However, he saw what seemed to be an expression of relief on their faces.
This situation made his hair stand on end.
"Boy, were you responsible for those people's deaths?"
When Chu Feng came to a cell deep in the Tianlao, a voice came from a cell on the left.
"Huh? Just think it's me who did it!"
Chu Feng walked into the cell.
The person imprisoned inside was an old man with a full beard, and his hair had grown long and scattered on the ground because he was kneeling on the ground.
Obviously, it was locked up for a long time.
